cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Failure Reveals the Mission
cards.instruction: Use each failed step to reveal a different goal the plan was secretly pursuing, then act immediately on that new mission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The treasure map ends at this solid wall. It secretly led us here to wake it. I'm knocking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nothing. And our torch is nearly out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then we were sent to hear it in darkness. I'm putting the torch out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can only hear you breathing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's it. The map was testing our breath control. I'm holding mine.

mechanism: A corrects how a partner interprets a failed treasure expedition, replacing each failure with a new secret mission and immediately starting its method.
confusable: D137 claims the same scheme worked as designed; D161 reveals a different goal after each failed step and acts on it.
comparison: A physical treasure search changes sensory tasks; the alternative changes a ship-radio assignment into performance and refusal training.
seedUse: Keep wall, dying torch and breathing as causes of successive missions; make the expert correct actual suggested responses.
